head: Running app without subscription: echoRnr costs $9.99 once
dek: echoRnr is a running app you buy once, with no ads and no monthly fee, and it lets you race a past run of your own or a friend's in real time. It came out on 19 November and was #18 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store the same day.
details: It maps runs, walks and bike rides by GPS, shows pace and mile splits, tracks personal records and works with Apple Watch. Friends' runs show up in a feed. Runs stay on your phone unless you share them, and you choose which ones friends see. It is made by Mark Kincaid Preyer.
where: iPhone and Apple Watch, App Store, $9.99 once
means: If you're tired of paying monthly just to see your own running stats, this app charges once.
todo: Find echoRnr in the App Store.
